summary: # Increff — Business Knowledge Base

## 1. What Is Increff? Increff is not a marketplace — it is Mensa's Warehouse Management System (WMS). It is a cloud-based logistics and operations platform that manages all of Mensa's order fulfilment across 23 different sales channels from 4 fulfilment centres across India. Increff integrates with marketplace channels, courier partners, ERP systems, and D2C storefronts — enabling real-time inventory sync, order processing, dispatch, and returns tracking from one unified system. It is purpose-built for fashion e-commerce and D2C brands operating at scale. In ZenStatement's pipeline, increff_sales and increff_returns represent the operations layer — the physical movement of goods — as distinct from the individual marketplace tables which represent the financial/settlement layer. ---

## 6. Transaction Lifecycle

### 6.1 Forward Order Flow (via Increff)  Customer orders on Marketplace / D2C ↓ Order pushed to Increff WMS in real-time ↓ increff_sales: order_status = 'READY_TO_DISPATCH' (sku_id, brand, channel, price, warehouse assigned) ↓ Increff: Pick → Pack → Manifest (fulfilment_channel = courier assigned) ↓

### 6.2 Replacement Order Flow  Buyer receives damaged / wrong item ↓ Increff creates REPLACEMENT order ↓ increff_sales: transaction_type = 'REPLACEMENT' (same flow as forward — new shipment dispatched) (no debit to buyer — free replacement)

### 6.3 Return Flow (Customer Return)  Buyer initiates return on marketplace / D2C ↓ Increff creates return order ↓ increff_returns: transaction_type = 'customer_return' order_status = 'created' ↓ Courier picks up from buyer (return_awb_number assigned) ↓

### 6.4 RTO (Return-to-Origin) Flow  Courier attempts delivery Buyer unreachable / address wrong / refused delivery ↓ Courier triggers RTO ↓ increff_returns: transaction_type = 'return_to_origin' return_order_type = 'RETURN_TO_ORIGIN' ↓ Item returned to dispatch warehouse return_order_status = 'COMPLETED'

## 9. Key Business Metrics (with SQL)

### 9.1 Cross-Channel GMV Summary sql SELECT sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, AVG(charged_amount) AS aov, AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - AVG(charged_amount) / NULLIF(AVG(mrp), 0)), 1) AS discount_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY gmv DESC;

### 9.2 Brand × Channel Revenue Matrix sql SELECT brand, sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY brand, sales_channel ORDER BY gmv DESC;

summary: ### 9.3 Return Rate by Channel (Mensa Brands Only) sql SELECT s.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS dispatched, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'customer_return' THEN r.order_id END) AS cust_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'return_to_origin' THEN r.order_id END) AS rto, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'customer_return' THEN r.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.transaction_type = 'return_to_origin' THEN r.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS rto_rate_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_sales s LEFT JOIN zs_observe.increff_returns r

### 9.4 COD Mix and RTO Risk sql SELECT sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cod_pct, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY cod_pct DESC; -- High COD % → Higher RTO risk (undelivered, refused orders)

### 9.5 Warehouse Throughput sql SELECT source_gst_id, source_city, COUNT(*) AS orders_dispatched, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS distinct_skus, COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS brands, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_channel) AS channels FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY source_gst_id, source_city ORDER BY orders_dispatched DESC;

### 9.6 Monthly Dispatch Trend sql SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_date AS DATE)) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders_dispatched, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod_orders, COUNT_IF(description = 'NCOD') AS prepaid_orders FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;  ---

## 1. Table Overview increff_returns is the unified returns tracking table for all of Mensa Brand Technologies' channels, managed through Increff WMS. It captures every inbound return event — buyer-initiated returns (customer returns), failed delivery returns (Return-to-Origin / RTO), and Shopify D2C returns with full WMS-level QC data. This table provides the operations view of returns — covering return order creation, physical receipt at the warehouse, QC inspection results, and the final status of returned inventory. Unlike marketplace-specific return tables, increff_returns consolidates returns from all channels into one operational dataset. summary: ### 8.1 Return Volume by Channel and Type sql SELECT sales_channel, transaction_type, COUNT(*) AS returns, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS return_value, AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_return_value FROM zs_observe.increff_returns WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY sales_channel, transaction_type ORDER BY returns DESC;

### 8.2 Monthly Return Trend sql SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS returns, COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'customer_return') AS customer_returns, COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'return_to_origin') AS rto, SUM(charged_amount) AS return_value FROM zs_observe.increff_returns WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

### 8.3 QC Pass/Fail Analysis (Shopify D2C) sql SELECT brand, sales_channel, COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'PASS') AS qc_pass, COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'FAIL') AS qc_fail, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status = 'FAIL') / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(return_order_qc_status IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS fail_rate_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_returns WHERE is_active = true AND return_order_qc_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY brand, sales_channel ORDER BY total_returns DESC;

### 8.4 Return Reasons (Shopify D2C) sql SELECT reason_for_return, COUNT(*) AS returns, SUM(charged_amount) AS total_value, AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_value, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_returns FROM zs_observe.increff_returns WHERE is_active = true AND reason_for_return IS NOT NULL GROUP BY reason_for_return ORDER BY returns DESC;

### 8.5 Return Rate (Sales vs Returns) sql SELECT s.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS sold_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS returned_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_sales s LEFT JOIN zs_observe.increff_returns r ON s.order_id = r.order_id AND r.is_active = true WHERE s.is_active = true AND s.order_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY s.sales_channel ORDER BY sold_orders DESC;

## 1. Table Overview increff_sales is the unified forward-order fulfilment log for all of Mensa Brand Technologies' sales channels, managed through Increff WMS (Warehouse Management System). Unlike the individual marketplace tables (myntra_oms, amazon_oms, etc.), this table aggregates all dispatched orders from a single operational source of truth — the Increff WMS system — across 23 distinct sales channels simultaneously. What Increff is: Increff is a cloud-based WMS platform that manages multi-channel order fulfilment for D2C brands and e-commerce sellers. It connects marketplaces, courier partners, and Mensa's own warehouses into one operational system — handling order ingestion, pick/pack, dispatch, and returns tracking. increff_sales represents all orders that passed through this WMS in 2025. ## 6. Data Quality Observations | Issue | Detail | Mitigation | |-------|--------|------------| | created_date stored as varchar | Format: 2025-12-31 — cannot natively date-filter | CAST(created_date AS DATE) | | charged_amount_excluding_tax NULL for \~19.6% | Tax breakdown incomplete for some channel integrations (Flipkart partial data) | Use charged_amount for GMV; compute tax from tax_igst_amount + tax_cgst_amount + tax_sgst_amount | | Many settlement fields are varchar | settled_amount, gross_commission, total_tcs_amount etc. are varchar staging fields — mostly NULL | These fields are not reliably populated in this table; use individual marketplace settlement tables for financial reconciliation | | 80+ fulfilment_channel variants | Same courier (e.g., Delhivery) appears as Delhivery, DELHIVERY, delhivery, Delhivery Surface, DLV, DL_CP etc. | Normalize: LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel))
## 7. Common Query Patterns

### 7.1 Monthly GMV by Channel sql SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(created_date AS DATE)) AS month, sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC;

### 7.2 Brand-Level Revenue Summary sql SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS distinct_skus, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, AVG(charged_amount) AS aov, AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - AVG(charged_amount) / NULLIF(AVG(mrp), 0)), 1) AS avg_discount_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY gmv DESC;

source_section: 7.3 COD vs Prepaid Mix by Channel
summary: ### 7.3 COD vs Prepaid Mix by Channel sql SELECT sales_channel, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') AS cod, COUNT_IF(description = 'NCOD') AS prepaid, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(description = 'COD') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS cod_pct FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY sales_channel ORDER BY total DESC;

### 7.4 Warehouse Dispatch Distribution sql SELECT source_gst_id, source_city, COUNT(*) AS dispatched_orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv, array_join(array_agg(DISTINCT sales_channel ORDER BY sales_channel), ' | ') AS channels FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY source_gst_id, source_city ORDER BY dispatched_orders DESC;

### 7.5 Top SKUs by Volume sql SELECT sku_id, brand, description AS payment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(charged_amount) AS revenue, AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_price, AVG(mrp) AS avg_mrp FROM zs_observe.increff_sales WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND transaction_type = 'SALES' GROUP BY sku_id, brand, description ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 30;

### 7.6 Courier Partner Distribution (Normalized) sql SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%delhivery%' THEN 'Delhivery' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%shadowfax%' THEN 'Shadowfax' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ekart%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ek_%' THEN 'Ekart' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%xpressbees%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%xbees%' THEN 'XpressBees' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%bluedart%' THEN 'BlueDart' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ecomexpress%' OR LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%ecx%' THEN 'EcomExpress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%flipkart%' THEN 'Flipkart Logistics' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fulfilment_channel)) LIKE '%myntra%' THEN 'Myntra Logistics'

Increff is not a marketplace; it is Mensa WMS / operations layer. increff_sales and increff_returns represent physical movement of goods, not marketplace financial settlement. It integrates marketplace channels, courier partners, ERP systems, and D2C storefronts.
